verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-261007-399 dated 07.10.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, for PO 4500318731. It lists CMP-GAM-004 at 22.600 PCS (4 packages) and CMP-GAM-009 at 34.000 PCS (6 packages). The total is 10 packages and 170 kg gross, and the carrier is given as PO 50466. The note says the goods are on EUR pallets and asks for their return. 'Meyer K.' signed by hand as the receiver. There are no corrections, strike-throughs or receiving stamps.
red_flags: Returnable EUR pallets are requested ('prosimy o zwrot').
No receiving date or stamp is on the document, only a handwritten receiver name.
Item descriptions are truncated on the document, so the full product names cannot be confirmed.
observations: Handwritten signature/name 'Meyer K.' above the signature line next to 'Odebrał:'. It overlaps the label slightly but is readable.
Item descriptions are cut off in the table ('(USK/PE' and '(fol').
Quantities use the Polish thousands separator (22.600 = 22600; 34.000 = 34000).
Package counts per line (4 + 6) match the stated total of 10.
No stamps or receiving date. The lower part of the page is blank.
